'''Boneyard''' was a factory [[City/Legends|city]] that was situated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nox (planet)|Nox]], in the [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]]. The city was situated within a large factory dome and the air in the city was barely breathable as a result of discharges of industrial fumes. In [[25,793 BBY]], the fugitive [[darksider]]s [[Daegen Lok]] and [[Tau (individual)|Xesh]] journeyed to Boneyard after escaping from imprisonment on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Bogan]] and they constructed [[Forcesaber]] weapons for themselves within the city's [[Gratz Foundry]].
